svg.text: one time step with cfg.twoPhaseFlow = true physics/two_phase.jl, solvers/two_phase_assembly.jl
melting and freezing on markers and cells, then the coupled solve for solid velocity, fluid and compaction pressure, then the porosity step
ΔF = (T − T_sol(P, C_dep)) / (ΔT_dep/F_max + L/c_p), capped at F_max − C_dep
the melt that leaves the parcel on its depletion-raised solidus after paying its latent heat; ΔT_dep/F_max = 500 K, L/c_p = 320 K
2 Freezing to equilibrium (cells that did not melt)
Δφ_f = min( φ, c_p (T_sol − T) / L )
20 % of the frozen volume erupts to the top populated cell of the column, the rest becomes basalt in place
φ += Σ_m w_m ΔF_m (1 − φ) / V, ΔT = [−L a_melt + L a_in − c_p (T − T_surf) a_er] / (c_p A)
V = r_C² Δr Δθ (the transport measure), A the exact cell measure; returned as H_magma through the heat-pipe channel
η = clamp(η_s exp(−α_φ φ), η_min, η_max), ζ = ζ_0 η φ^(−m_ζ)
α_φ = 27.0, ζ_0 = 1.0, m_ζ = 1.0; η_s prescribed here (1019 plume head, 1023 lid)
K_D = k_0 φ^n / μ, δ = sqrt( K_D (ζ + 4η/3) )
k_0 = 1.0×10-9 m², n = 3.0, μ = 1.0 Pa s; Δr = 30.6 km: δ < Δr means compaction is not resolved
Δρ = 500 kg/m³; restores the radial mean the solid buoyancy removed (zero here); melt buoyancy φ Δρ g joins the solid buoyancy
div τ − ∇p̃ − ∇p_c + b = 0, D v_s + D q = 0, D v_s + p_c/ζ = 0, q = −K_D (∇p̃ − Δρ_seg g e_r)
one direct MUMPS solve + one refinement step, donor directions refreshed; total-volume residual 3.5e-16 of max |D v_s|
p_c 2.0×105 Pa, K_D Δρ_seg g 0.198 cm/yr
p_c 1.0×108 Pa, K_D Δρ_seg g 0.00259 cm/yr
Δt ≤ C_φ Δx / (|v_s| + |q|/φ_face), Δt ≤ C_φ Δx/|q|, Δt ≤ 0.5 φ / ((1 − φ) |D v_s|)
C_φ = 0.5, over the faces and cells carrying melt; the step taken is min(20 kyr, 419 kyr) = 20 kyr
φ* = φ + Δt R(φ, v_s), φ ← φ + (Δt/2) [R(φ, v_s) + R(φ*, v_s*)], R = −[div(φ v_s)]_TVD + D v_s
v_s* from a second solve at φ*; van Leer fluxes, the solver's own divergence; Σ V φ changes by -1.2e-16, no cell below zero
advective form on the Darcy face fluxes, beside H_magma; the cell above the melting cell is the lid base, 518 K colder
